pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit complex, stellate geometries with high-frequency angular projections. Pixel gradients at patch edges are distinct. Spatial area of patches is heterogeneous, primarily occupying the mid-to-lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light interstitial pelage forms a continuous network of linear pathways. Junction nodes primarily consist of 3-way and 4-way intersections. Pathway thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the visible lateral profile.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, erect mane is visible along the dorsal neck line, presenting a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated edge against the background.
